create.name: Jessica Amos
create.bio:
Jessica Amos is a mindfulness meditation teacher, life coach and writer in Salem, Oregon. She traces her own awakening to 2005, after the birth of her first child, and came to meditation some years later through a 21-day online challenge she had at first resisted. In 2013 she started Stay with Yourself as an online storytelling co-op, began leading meditation classes at a local yoga studio, and a year later released her first online course. She has given two TEDx talks, including You Are Your Greatest Ally at TEDxSalem, and between 2020 and 2025 taught remote resilience classes for adults in custody at Oregon State Penitentiary.

Her teaching is plain-spoken, warm and seasonal, with an emphasis on self-compassion and being on your own side. On Insight Timer and through her Substack library she offers courses on learning to meditate, sacred habits, compassionate boundaries, the inner child, shadow work, the wheel of the year and finding God outside organised religion, alongside bedtime stories for children. In Salem she runs meditation classes, half-day retreats and talks for schools and organisations, and she coaches clients one-to-one. She also writes poetry, plays in an all-woman punk band and published a poetic memoir, My Life in Moments.

books.title: My Life in Moments: A Poetic Memoir
books.author: Jessica Amos
books.description: A memoir told in short poems and fragments of memory, from a childhood with two born-again parents who had served prison time to the questions of love, faith and forgiveness that followed. Written in 2013 and published years later.

courses.title: 1-on-1 Coaching with Jessica
courses.description: Coaching for people at a crossroads, in a personal awakening or wanting steadier habits, with homework between calls and meditation tools tailored to each client. Options run from a single 75-minute session to three or six months of regular calls.
courses.price: $500 USD (single 75-minute session); $5,000 USD (3 months, 10 sessions); $9,950 USD (6 months, 20 sessions)

courses.title: Learn to Meditate: Create a Soulful & Lifelong Meditation Practice
courses.description: A self-paced eight-week online course with a video lesson, a guided meditation and journaling prompts each week, moving from posture and breath through mantra, gratitude and shadow work to coming home to yourself. It includes MP3s, a workbook and an online community.

courses.title: Sacred Habits
courses.description: A five-week programme for building one heart-led daily habit at a time, looking at why some habits never stick and choosing ones that truly suit you. Weekly videos, reflective prompts and a private community.

courses.title: Meditation Classes in Salem, Oregon
courses.description: In-person guided meditation classes for beginners and regular meditators, covering breath, awareness of thoughts and self-compassion. Dates are announced to her class mailing list.

courses.title: Speaking, Workshops & Events
courses.description: Keynotes, workshops, retreats and facilitated sessions on mindfulness, relationships and burnout prevention for conferences, schools, workplaces and wellness groups, drawing on her storytelling background.

courses.title: Finding God After Religion
courses.description: A five-day Insight Timer course for people who have left, or are leaving, the church and still want a connection with the divine. It follows her own path from a strict religious upbringing through the unsettled years after leaving, towards a faith rooted in love.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing
courses.description: A twelve-day Insight Timer course introducing shadow work, with short teachings and practices for meeting the parts of yourself you tend to hide.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Jessica Amos on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, mindfulness talks and a large set of retold fairy tales for children at bedtime. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Soul Thriving Mini-Course and Guidebook
free_resources.description: A free short course and guidebook on living with more care for yourself, sent by email when you sign up. A good way into her teaching style.

Salem half-day retreat (Saturday 27 April, no year) and Summer Camp for Grownups (22 August) are past; Meditation Classes page has no dates, so kept undated.
Book ASIN B0GW8588RY taken from the Amazon US link on her books page; format not confirmed (Bookshop lists ISBN 9798903298112).
